title: Hive

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Hive is a boss resembling a retextured, upgraded version of Bonemass. It can only be spawned via Console Commands.
Hive deals Spirit damage instead of Poison damage with its attacks, spawns Mistlands-related minions, and drops items similar to what The Queen drops. It could be an incomplete placeholder boss for the Mistlands, which was eventually replaced with The Queen.

sections.heading: Melee
sections.text: A close-range swipe at a player.

sections.heading: Area of Effect
sections.text: Hive will charge up with a thick green cloud before releasing a wave of ooze. This is signaled when he leans backwards.

sections.heading: Spawn
sections.text: At intervals, Hive will reach into his armpit to throw out a glob of goop. This is never directed at a player, and will spawn up to four random monsters ( Seekers and/or Ticks) where it lands. No more of a creature type will be spawned once eight of that type are already present.

sections.heading: Ranged
sections.text: A ranged attack (it is unclear what it looks like in action). It has a 30 meter range. Bonemass does not have an analogue to this attack.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Despite visually resembling a red Bonemass, Hive is probably an unused Mistlands Boss since its spawns and drops are Mistlands creatures/items.

Introduction. Hive is a boss resembling a retextured, upgraded version of Bonemass. It can only be spawned via Console Commands.
Hive deals Spirit damage instead of Poison damage with its attacks, spawns Mistlands-related minions, and drops items similar to what The Queen drops. It could be an incomplete placeholder boss for the Mistlands, which was eventually replaced with The Queen.

Melee. A close-range swipe at a player.

Area of Effect. Hive will charge up with a thick green cloud before releasing a wave of ooze. This is signaled when he leans backwards.

Spawn. At intervals, Hive will reach into his armpit to throw out a glob of goop. This is never directed at a player, and will spawn up to four random monsters ( Seekers and/or Ticks) where it lands. No more of a creature type will be spawned once eight of that type are already present.

Ranged. A ranged attack (it is unclear what it looks like in action). It has a 30 meter range. Bonemass does not have an analogue to this attack.

Notes. • Despite visually resembling a red Bonemass, Hive is probably an unused Mistlands Boss since its spawns and drops are Mistlands creatures/items.
